svg.title: Sidira mark
svg.desc: Six-blade diaphragm — overlapping triangular blades around a hexagonal aperture. Outer pivots at radius 40, inner vertices at radius 13, both on angles 30°/90°/150°/210°/270°/330° (SVG convention, clockwise from +x). Stroke uses currentColor so the consumer controls the ink. Recommended stroke-width by render size when consumed at scale: 6 at 16px output, 3.5 at 32px, 2.25 at 48px, 1.2 at 96px, 0.7 at 240px+.
